items.label: la santé
items.scene: A rosy, fit grandma sitting in a bright SUN-beam raises her cup of TEA ("sahn-TAY") to wish everyone good HEALTH.

items.label: la fatigue
items.scene: A FAT TIGER cub ("fah-TEEG") lies sprawled asleep across two waiting-room chairs, worn out with TIREDNESS, one paw dangling.

items.label: la grippe
items.scene: A penguin with the FLU, scarf round its neck, GRIPS ("GREEP") a hot-water bottle tight and sneezes a puff of snowflakes.

items.label: la toux
items.scene: A girl with a COUGH covers her face politely, and the TOUCAN ("TOO") perched on her chair back looks on with concern.

items.label: l'ardeur
items.scene: A puppy leaps up at the little coat-cupboard DOOR ("DUHR") with such ARDOUR that its tail is a blur.

items.label: le virus
items.scene: A grumpy green fuzzy VIRUS ("vee-REWS") puppet bounces off old RUTH's open umbrella as she sits waiting.

items.label: le soulagement
items.scene: Sue (recurring character: a cheerful 10-year-old girl with two black bunches tied with yellow ribbons, red raincoat, yellow wellies) lifts a huge sack of potatoes off a LARGE MAN's back ("soo-LAHZH-MAHN"), and he sighs with RELIEF, arms flung wide.
